import subprocess,json,time
lock='/tmp/lcb-qbe-bootstrap-tests-control.lock'
p=subprocess.Popen(['flock','-x',lock,'python3','-u','-c','import time; print("held",flush=True); time.sleep(0.5)'],stdout=subprocess.PIPE,text=True)
assert p.stdout.readline().strip()=='held'
r=subprocess.run(['flock','-n',lock,'true'],capture_output=True,text=True)
assert r.returncode==1,r.returncode
assert p.wait()==0
r2=subprocess.run(['flock','-n',lock,'true'],capture_output=True,text=True)
assert r2.returncode==0
print(json.dumps({'blocked_while_held':r.returncode,'acquired_after_release':r2.returncode}))
